response.original_title: Can Evrenol: From Baskin to Sayara
response.overview: Recorded at the HARD:LINE Film Festival 2025 in Regensburg, Viva la Movielucion sits down9 with filmmaker Can Evrenol to talk about his career from Baskin to his martial arts revenge film Sayara, which won the festival's Golden Razor Blade for Best Feature. The interview was later included as a bonus feature on the German 4K UHD Mediabook release of Sayara.
response.title: Can Evrenol: From Baskin to Sayara
